subject.title: fix(logging): keep JSON console output structured across CLI routes

question: Should OpenClaw treat every repaired early-startup and direct diagnostic path as part of the existing `logging.consoleStyle: "json"` JSONL contract, while retaining raw explicit command-result JSON?
rationale: The implementation is intentionally broad across CLI and diagnostic paths, so the remaining question is product and compatibility acceptance rather than a mechanical code repair.

options.title: Accept the widened opt-in contract
options.body: Merge after confirming JSONL is the intended output for these repaired diagnostics and raw `writeJson()` results remain the supported exception.

options.title: Narrow the scope
options.body: Retain the original captured-console and subsystem fixes but exclude selected pre-capture diagnostics if their historic plain-text form is a supported operator contract.

recommendation.title: Accept the widened opt-in contract
recommendation.body: Merge after confirming JSONL is the intended output for these repaired diagnostics and raw `writeJson()` results remain the supported exception.

likelyOwner.reason: The current branch integrates the affected logging and CLI boundaries and is best positioned to clarify intended compatibility semantics.
